shape: nobody talks about a small, true feeling everyone has had

slides.text: nobody talks about how you still [[buy the cheap tea]] because your first roommate swore the yellow box tasted exactly the same.

caption:
you lived on cheap pasta and shared a toaster that only worked on one side.
you still can't go down the hot drinks aisle without thinking of them.
send this to the roommate who shared your first terrible kitchen.
alt: a small green donkey wearing glasses holds a hoof to its chin with a knowing look next to text about buying cheap tea because of an old roommate.
